raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 has ingest_ts values from 02:00 up to 22:00 and about 21 more rows than a typical batch, which looks like a re-delivery of already-loaded txn_ids. Silver does not deduplicate, so the same txn_id is counted twice in every gold table. The fix keeps the latest-ingested version of each txn_id and applies the POSTED filter afterwards, so a later REVERSED row supersedes an earlier POSTED one.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
